mutations.contract_domain: Positive precision drops derived by Context.apply from admitted coefficients and validated contexts, not arbitrary negative helper arguments.
mutations.reason: Context.apply is the only production caller and derives a positive host-sized drop. Inverting OR to AND removes early refusal, but checkedExponent still rejects over-limit sums; any signed overflow is near MinInt64, outside the admitted int32 range. Accepted exponents and the public ErrLimit refusal remain unchanged.

mutations.contract_domain: Ratio comparison of admitted coefficient magnitudes used by Context.Quo through divide.
mutations.reason: Changing exponent >= 0 to > 0 differs only at zero. integerMagnitude(0) is zero, so adding it to either effective digit length leaves every comparison and result unchanged.

mutations.contract_domain: Virtual-zero ratio comparison of admitted coefficients whose bit budgets bound actual decimal string lengths below host MaxInt.
mutations.reason: Changing the left loop comparison from < to <= only adds an iteration after both actual digit strings end. Inner indexing guards remain <, so both virtual digits are zero and the result is unchanged. Admitted bit lengths keep the extra increment within host int range.
